newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Guests leap from Philippine hotel on fire, 7 dead.
newsitem.headline: Guests leap from Philippine hotel on fire, 7 dead.

text.p: At least seven people died and more than 20 were injured in a fire that razed the upper floors of a popular hotel in Cotabato city in the southern Philippines early on Saturday, police said.
The injured included guests who jumped out of windows to escape, witnesses said.
Firemen said they were still searching the rooms of the six-storey Imperial Hotel and they feared the death toll might rise.
"I was asleep in my room when I woke up feeling as if I was choking. It was the smoke," said hotel guest Jimmy Malcampo, who survived with leg injuries after leaping through a third floor window.
"I rushed out of my room and saw the hall on fire. My choice was to die or jump out of the window. I jumped," he told reporters.
The fire broke out at about 12:30 a.m. and was put out two and a half hours later.
"The number of casualties might still increase because we are still searching the rooms," fire chief Irael Dilawangan told reporters.
The fire started on the third floor and quickly spread to the fourth and fifth floors of the hotel in downtown Cotabato, according to police.
Firemen were investigating the cause of the blaze.
